## SCUM Tactical Map & Chat Translator v2.1.1

### What's new in 2.1.1
Releases now also include the full `.zip` package (exe + instructions). Everything from 2.1.0 is included below.

### ⚠️ Updating from v2.0.0
The updater in v2.0.0 is broken (it downloads the file but never installs it). **Download `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe` (or `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe`) below and replace your old exe once.** Your `config.json` and `points.json` stay untouched. From v2.1.1 on, updates install with one click.

### Fixed
- **Auto-update now really updates the app.** The build is saved to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\SCUM_Chat_Translator\updates`, verified (size, executable header, SHA-256), swapped in place (the previous build is kept as `.old` until the next start, automatic rollback on failure) and the app restarts by itself. The Normal / Portable build is matched automatically.
- "Clear all" waypoints now asks for confirmation.
- User files (`config.json`, `points.json`, `profiles.json`) are written atomically and never touched by updates.
- Missing `requests` dependency added to `requirements.txt`.

### Added
- **Steam-style update window:** compact progress bar with speed and ETA, cancel / retry, release notes on demand.
- **Background update checks** every few hours (configurable).
- **Chat history window** (tray menu): search, filters (player, type, translated only), export to TXT / CSV / JSON, optional on-disk persistence.
- **Blocked-word filter:** mask, hide the message, or show it untranslated; whole-word and case options.
- **Language auto-detection:** skips translation when a message is already in your language (or in languages you list).
- **Settings profiles:** named presets switchable from Settings or the tray menu.
- **Waypoint import / export** (JSON) with merge or replace.
- **Language tab:** locales are discovered automatically from `assets/locales/*.json` (see `docs/ADDING_A_LANGUAGE.md`).
- Rotating log file in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\SCUM_Chat_Translator\logs`.
- Every new feature has its own switch in Settings.

### Changed
- The interface ships in English only (the earlier Ukrainian and Russian translations are archived in `docs/locales_archive`).
- Application controller moved to `core/controller.py`; code comments are English; `print` replaced by logging.
- Repository: `pyproject.toml`, ruff, CI (lint + tests) and release build workflows, docs, contribution and security policies. Personal data and binaries are no longer tracked.

### First launch
Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time. This is normal for free unsigned apps and is **not** a virus warning: click **More info → Run anyway** once. Details and screenshots are in the [README](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map#-windows-says-protected-your-pc--is-this-a-virus).

### Files
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe` — standard build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe` — portable build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_v2.1.1.zip` — full package: exe + instructions

`config.json`, `points.json` and `profiles.json` are not shipped: the app creates them next to the exe on first launch, so an update never overwrites your own settings and waypoints.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
